title: Execution Completion and Merge-Concurrency Hardening
purpose: Restore executable OPS3 enforcement for bounded Continue completion and serialize publication to main so concurrent conversations cannot race or invalidate exact-tree evidence.
scope: add an OPS3-native nonterminal response/termination guard without restoring Operations V2 authority
make multi-Continue and stall incidents machine-visible execution-conformance failures rather than silently clean
add a compare-and-swap publication lease for main merges in Multiversal-app and multiversal-aioc
require fresh target-main reconciliation under the lease before merge and exact durable-result verification before release
batch multi-file control-plane projections atomically to reduce serial writes and partial closeouts
add focused regressions for premature terminal response, multi-Continue certification, stale-main publication and competing lease acquisition
non_goals: change product priority or start PCA-13
restore Operations V2 as an authority source
require a long-lived pre-main branch as a second source of truth
depend on GitHub repository administration features unavailable to the connected executor
acceptance_criteria: an in-progress bounded Continue cannot pass the OPS3 response gate as terminal without an owner-only or external blocker record
a completed checkpoint with more than one Continue cannot report a clean execution-conformance result
publication protocol uses a compare-and-swap merge lease and rejects stale-main merge authorization
two competing lease acquisitions from the same observed lease head cannot both succeed
multi-file control-plane projection guidance uses one tree/commit/ref update rather than sequential file commits
OPS3 repository validation and focused regressions pass on the exact candidate
PCA-13 remains selected_not_started with no implementation authority after closeout
